# Data used by the analysis (all inputs; nothing here is generated by the scripts)

| File | What | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `meta_n3000_s42_w501.csv` | 6,000 sampled variants (3,000/class, seed 42): chromosome, pos, ref, alt, class, fold group | sampled from the Feng et al. (2025) pathogenic benchmark |
| `emb/{dnabert2,hyenadna,kmer4}_{ref,alt}_n3000_s42_w501.npy` | frozen embeddings of the 501-bp reference/alternate window, row-aligned with the meta file | computed earlier in the HMS DNA-FM benchmark project |
| `vep_pathogenic_coding.csv` | annotation table (consequence string, ClinVar review status) | `dna_foundation_benchmark/data_processed/.../vep_pathogenic_coding.csv` from ChongWuLab/dna_foundation_benchmark (Feng et al. 2025) |
| `alphagenome/patho_{ref,alt}.npy` | AlphaGenome 128-bp mean-pooled embeddings (1,018 x 3,072) for the upstream test split | alphagenome-pytorch run earlier in the HMS project |
| `alphagenome/alphagenome_test_meta.csv` | chromosome, pos, ref, alt, class for those 1,018 rows (all chr8), in embedding order | test split of `seqs_pathogenic_short.csv` (Feng et al.) |

Licensing to check before making the repository public:
- `vep_pathogenic_coding.csv` is redistributed from the Feng et al. repository; confirm its licence.
- The AlphaGenome embeddings are derivatives of model parameters/outputs subject to the Google DeepMind AlphaGenome Model Terms; confirm that sharing them is permitted.
